evaluation.test_policy: Lock joint source-validation selection after both fresh trainings before any new test prediction; historical source test descriptive only

provenance.scope: Exactly two new full seed42 trainings: B1A6H2 then L3A6H2; four cached standalone controls; no warm starts, new standalone controls, multiseed or external inference.
provenance.precision: preserve CP1 torch.float32 and PyTorch 1.11 TF32 defaults; no AMP
provenance.initialization: one shared ImageNet-initialized state_dict, verified tensor-by-tensor for both baselines
provenance.cp1: artifacts immutable; separate CP2 manifest, evaluator policy and run directories

phase_a.loss: B1 unchanged: source Dice(sigmoid(logits)) + source focal_with_logits(logits)
phase_a.stage_indexing: zero-based source decoder.blocks; concatenated pre-conv channels 176/128, spatial 56/112 at input 224; decoder block 4 unchanged

deferred.A4: NOT RUN — spatial gate deferred until evidence from global gate; no automatic stage-placement/combination matrix

fusion.baseline: attention2(x)+attention1(x); normalized equivalent weights [2/3,1/3,0] at scale 3
fusion.constant_gate: one 3-vector per stage, trainable, initialized from log prior
fusion.input_gate: GAP(input) -> Linear(C,max(8,C//16)) -> ReLU -> Linear(hidden,3) + log_prior; last weights/bias zero; softmax branch axis
fusion.local: DWConv(C,C,3,padding=1,groups=C,bias=True) -> PWConv(C,1,1,bias=True) -> sigmoid; no intermediate activation or normalization
fusion.new_initialization: fork_rng CPU, seed 42+20000+stage for local/capacity; +100 for input-gate; +200 for CBAM; original full state loaded exactly from P before additions

capacity.A5: original P-scSE + DWConv3x3(C,C) -> PWConv(C,h) -> ReLU -> PWConv(h,C); h=round(max(8,C//16)/2), last PW weights/bias zero
capacity.comparison: added active parameters within 5% of A3 added active parameters; actual operations and output RMS reported; no exact functional equivalence claimed

cbam.implementation: avg+max shared channel MLP reduction 16; max+mean spatial concat -> Conv7x7 biasFalse -> BatchNorm(eps1e-5,momentum0.01) -> sigmoid
cbam.caveat: matched upper gain bound 3, not midpoint/distribution; two sigmoid maps midpoint gives 0.75x vs source 1.5x; replacement comparator, not isolated local-branch ablation

expansion_gate.requires: completed real A1, validation only, all integrity and finite-gradient checks passed
expansion_gate.pass_action: Write A1 diagnosis and gate decision BEFORE launching A2/A3/A5/A6, then sequential bounded comparisons without test access
expansion_gate.fail_action: Stop expansion; document remaining candidates not run; keep A0; evaluate only executed model after locked selection
expansion_gate.meaning: feasibility gate, not acceptance/improvement criterion; allows testing whether learned fusion resolves a modest fixed-fusion tradeoff

requires: validation Image Dice strictly higher than A0/B1
selection.ranking: highest overall validation Image Dice; exact ties favor earlier A1,A2,A3,A5,A6; retain A0 if none eligible
selection.latency: reported using same-image shared-GPU sequential inference including cached A0; not a noisy wall-time tuning criterion
selection.test_access: selection persisted before all new test probabilities, no architecture or loss changes from test

analysis.gate_collapse: validation per-image/stage mean, std, normalized entropy, fraction max weight >0.95, subgroups for evaluation only
interventions: A1/A3 drop_local with remaining weights renormalized
A3 fixed_prior_gate instead of input gate
analysis.intervention_policy: descriptive validation only AFTER primary selection, no retraining, not evidence of robust training or causal physiological importance

phase_h.head: Conv2d(32,1,1,bias=True); bilinear logits to 224x224; align_corners=False
phase_h.main_objective: B1 source Dice(sigmoid(z)) + corrected-logit Focal; unchanged
phase_h.auxiliary_objective: same B1 primitives for H1/H2; weight 0.1; target is the ONLY H1-vs-H2 difference

targets.H2: 3x3 morphological gradient, dilation minus erosion, explicit zero exterior, from actual augmented binary mask

phase_h.inference: primary mask uses original source network only; auxiliary head can be omitted; no GT at inference

expansion_gate.policy: H1 full validation diagnosis persisted before H2; gate feasibility only, not acceptance

selection.ranking: highest validation Image Dice among eligible, tie H1 before H2; otherwise retain H0

phase_h.interpretation: one-seed standalone auxiliary supervision screen; no selected attention from A; no novelty/clinical claim

objectives.L3: B1 + fixed 0.01 foreground signed-distance boundary term

tversky.aggregation: entire batch and pixels; no per-image weighting

boundary.empty_mask: zero distance map; regional loss remains active
boundary.reduction: mean over all batch/channel/pixels, including zero-map empty masks
boundary.distance_target_timing: computed from binary ground truth AFTER geometric augmentation in each batch

selection.metric: highest validation Image Dice among eligible selected checkpoints; exact tie favors L0 then L1,L2,L3,L4
selection.candidate_eligibility: validation Image Dice > L0; small-wound Image Dice >= L0; GT-positive TP=0 count <= L0; GT-empty images with FP <= L0
selection.policy_if_none_eligible: retain L0; show all validation trade-offs without claiming an acceptable improvement
selection.caveat: conservative exploratory screening rule, not a clinically validated acceptance threshold
selection.test_access: No candidate test predictions before validation-only selection.json is saved; all four test results reported afterwards

phase_l.scope: L.1 one-seed screening only. Diagnose L.2 factors separately after screening; no automatic L5-L7 matrix, architecture changes, external data or multi-seed confirmation.

main_loss.L3A6H2: L3 = B1 + 0.01 signed-distance foreground boundary loss

combinations.auxiliary_loss: 0.1 * B1(auxiliary logits, actual augmented 3x3 morphological boundary); unchanged in both conditions
combinations.initialization: Same original shared base tensors + exact historical A6 CBAM tensors + exact historical H2 head tensors; paired tensor by tensor; no trained warm-start
combinations.selection: Original CP2 overall/small/boundary/miss/empty-FP/1% capacity guards against B1, plus higher overall validation Image Dice than relevant standalone A6/H2 (and L3 for L3 condition); rank eligible by validation Dice; tie favors B1A6H2. If none, B1 retained.
contrasts: L3A6H2 vs B1A6H2 on exactly paired architecture/initialization/inputs
combinations.interpretation: Exploratory one-seed follow-up. Not a complete 2^3 factorial: L3+A6 and L3+H2 not run; no three-way synergy claim. All previous guard failures preserved.
